cohort: Mothers who delivered at Sioux Lookout Meno Ya Win Health Centre (SLMHC) or other small Ontario hospitals
finding: Mothers with diabetes in pregnancy who delivered at SLMHC differed substantially from mothers delivering at Ontario hospitals with a comparable level of service, with a higher prevalence of type 2 diabetes, younger age, greater parity, and increased substance use, while their neonates experienced similar outcomes except for increased macrosomia, neonatal hypoglycaemia, and hyperbilirubinaemia in GDM pregnancies.
